description_en: Generates the URL and detailed information for uploading an update package file to OSS
description_zh: 生成升级包文件上传到OSS的URL及详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot generate-ota-upload-url --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --file-suffix apk --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateOTAUploadURL

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The file name extension of the update package file. Valid values:

bin (default)
dav
apk
tar
gz
tar.gz
zip
gzip
parameters.help_zh:
升级包文件扩展名。可选扩展名：

bin（默认）
dav
apk
tar
gz
tar.gz
zip
gzip
parameters.name: file_suffix

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The file upload information returned if the call was successful. For more information, see the following parameters
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的文件上传信息。详情见以下参数信息

FirmwareUrl.description_en:
The URL of the file, which is the storage address of the file in Object Storage Service (OSS).

The file URL is in the format of `https://BucketName.Endpoint/ObjectName`, where BucketName is the bucket name, Endpoint is the file access domain name (for Endpoint information of each region, see [Regions and endpoints]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html）), and ObjectName is the full path of the file including the folder and file name extension.

After the update package file is uploaded, use this parameter to call the [CreateOTAFirmware]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html） operation to create the update package
FirmwareUrl.description_zh:
文件的URL，即文件在对象存储（OSS）上的存储地址。

文件URL的格式为`https://BucketName.Endpoint/ObjectName`。其中，BucketName是Bucket名称，Endpoint是文件访问域名（各地域的Endpoint信息，请参见[访问域名和数据中心]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html）），ObjectName是包含文件夹以及文件后缀在内的该文件的完整路径。

升级包文件上传成功后，使用此参数调用[CreateOTAFirmware]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html）接口创建升级包

Key.description_en: The name of the object (file) to be uploaded by calling the OSS PostObject operation, including the full path of the OSS object
Key.description_zh: 调用OSS的接口PostObject上传对象（即文件）的名称，包含OSS对象的完整路径

OSSAccessKeyId.description_en:
The AccessKey ID of the OSS bucket owner.

This OSS bucket stores the file
OSSAccessKeyId.description_zh:
OSS Bucket拥有者的AccessKey ID。

该OSS Bucket将存储文件

ObjectStorage.description_en: The object storage type. Default value: OSS

Policy.description_en: The parameter used by OSS to verify the validity of the request form fields
Policy.description_zh: OSS通过该参数验证请求表单域的合法性

Signature.description_en: The signature information calculated based on AccessKeySecret and Policy. When calling the OSS API, OSS verifies this signature information to confirm the validity of the Post request
Signature.description_zh: 根据AccessKeySecret和Policy计算出的签名信息。调用OSS API时，OSS验证该签名信息，从而确认Post请求的合法性

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the file upload URL was generated, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: 生成文件上传URL的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
